# 1. Grand General Staff & Corps Logistics (总参谋部与大军团后勤 — Military Hegemon)
oe_heg2_cab_grand_general_staff = {
	ability = mil
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations > 0
		oe_heg2_can_use_mil_tools = yes
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			scope:is_active ?= yes
			oe_heg2_can_use_mil_tools = yes
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_heg2_cab_grand_general_staff_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_heg2_cab_grand_general_staff_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				controller ?= scope:actor
			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_heg2_cab_grand_general_staff
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	country_modifier = {
		discipline = 0.03
		army_logistics_distance_modifier = 0.20
		army_maintenance_efficiency = -0.05
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_supply_limit_modifier = 0.25
		local_manpower_modifier = 0.15
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 18 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = yes }
				add = { value = 20 }
			}
		}
	}
}
